The memo appropriately identifies these as "N/A" since they're not specified in the waiver document.

The memo successfully captures the material terms that are present:
- The waiver period (November 9, 2021 to May 10, 2022)
- The modified unrestricted cash covenant ($10 million reduced to $9 million minimum)
- The specific covenant sections being waived
- The borrower and lender entities
- The operational changes (cessation of mining operations)
- The underlying credit agreement date (May 29, 2020)

All key financial and covenant terms from the source waiver document are appropriately reflected in the memo.
